sloka: वृथागर्जितनिश्चेष्टा राक्षस्यः पिशिताशनाः ।रावणाय शशंसुस्ताः सीताध्यवसितं महत् ।। ५.५८.८१ ।।।।
transliteration: vṛthāgarjitaniśceṣṭā rākṣasyaḥ piśitāśanāḥ ।rāvaṇāya śaśaṁsustāḥ sītādhyavasitaṁ mahat ।। 5.58.81 ।।।।

translations.english: "Since the threatenings of the shedemons were of no use the ogresses who live on flesh and blood reported to Ravana about great Sita's formidable determination.
